answer: A bond that ripens only with time. Every agent locks a deposit that vests epoch by epoch, and each attestation is weighted by how much vesting it survived, so a swarm of clones minted at dusk arrives with almost no pigment on the page. Value moving between identities must prove shared control of one external address, folding both into a kinship node capped at an honest agent's ceiling. Like light through a prism, tenure splits the crowd into honest beams and one cheap echo.
